content.title: Will Publix be open on Easter in 2026? | WFLA
content.text: Skip to content by: Alaina Papazian Posted: Apr 3, 2026 / 05:03 PM EDT Updated: Apr 3, 2026 / 05:03 PM EDT SHARE TAMPA, Fla. (WFLA) — Those who find themselves craving a “pub sub” for Easter dinner this Sunday will be disappointed, as the grocery chain announced that all of its stores and pharmacies will be closed for the holiday. Easter is celebrated by Christians across the world after 40 days of Lent. In honor of this, Publix has always given its employees the day off to enjoy the holiday and spend some time with family. Publix will be open for normal hours on Saturday if you need to squeeze in a last-minute grocery run. As for Sunday, here’s a list of places that will be open incase you need some last-minute items: 7-Eleven CVS Dollar General Dollar Tree Family Dollar Fresh Market Sprouts Trader Joe’s Walgreens Walmart Whole Foods Certain locations may close for the holidays or have different hours than usual. Check with individual stores to confirm their hours.
